Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 browsers (you, the dispatcher, and a second Admin) · about 20 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List. You are the dispatcher.
  • A second browser signed in as an Admin at the same location (used to change a status and deactivate a technician during the test).
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha" and, for this case only, "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Ben Bravo" (called Ben in the steps; step 6 deactivates him).
  • Four customers for this case only, each with a contact and an asset: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Focus Kept Alpha Co", "… Bravo Co", "… Charlie Co", "… Golf Co" (the steps use the end of the name).
  • One Approved work order per customer: Alpha Co and Bravo Co led by Ana, Charlie Co led by Ben, Golf Co with no lead.
  • The Status filter starts with nothing ticked.
  • From step 4 on, use only the keyboard. Where focus should go is not designed yet: try Tab, Shift+Tab, the arrow keys, Enter, Space and Escape, and write down what each does.

Setup

  1. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha" and "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Ben Bravo".
  2. Customers: for each of the four names, Customers > New Customer > Name > Save; on its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save; on its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model > Save.
  3. Work orders for "each customer": Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the Customer and its Asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In the New Line form that opens, type in "What Are You Doing?" and pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Service - Full grease service"), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close: the status reads Approved. Write down the work order number (top left). Then pick the lead in Lead Technician on the card at the left of the work order page; it saves at once.
    • Alpha Co: lead = ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha.
    • Bravo Co: lead = ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha.
    • Charlie Co: lead = ZZAUTOTEST F3 Ben Bravo.
    • Golf Co: no lead.
  4. Check: Work Orders > All tab > List > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Focus Kept" shows exactly these 4, all Approved, with the leads above.
